text:
Priya (PM): ok team - we need to pick a path for the upcoming pilot with ACME. do we prioritize feature parity (their ask) or ship a differentiated bundle faster with tighter SLOs? need a decision by EOD so sales can commit pricing.

Derek (Eng): parity takes ~3 sprints if we include tenant-routing + full RBAC. MVP plus key parity for ACME could be 1 sprint (routing + token-policy).

Sam (SRE): SLO impact: full parity path will increase work but keeps us at 99.95% target. compressed timeline -> risk of regressions, expect transient latency spikes during rollout. we can mitigate with a temporary relaxed SLO for pilot: 99.8% and explicit fallback model route.

Liam (Sales): ACME's legal team is firm on functional parity for their compliance checklist. they're open to pilot credits but not after-the-fact surprises. if we do a reduced-SLO pilot, we must surface that in the pilot agreement.

Maya (ProdOps): pragmatic option: scope the pilot as "parity-critical subset" (routing + audit logs + kms passthrough). hold advanced optimizations (adaptive batching, cost-aware routing) for GA. that buys speed while satisfying ACME checklist.

Derek (Eng): +1 to Maya. Implementation sketch: deliver parity subset, ship canary to ACME's tenant with feature-flag and explicit kill-switch. owners: me for runtime, @Sam for SLO gating, @Priya for legal/terms.

Sam (SRE): for gating we propose these controls:
```
- canary percent: 5% of ACME traffic
- perceived-latency alert: p99 > 800ms -> auto-scale + throttle
- safety SLA: rollback on 3 consecutive deploy errors
```

Priya (PM): agreed. we need a pricing compromise: pilot pricing with reduced monthly commit + credits on GA if we hit 99.95. Liam, can you draft language for pilot agreement calling out relaxed SLO + credits?

Liam (Sales): yes, will draft. i'll add acceptance criteria: parity subset must pass ACME's audit checklist and no critical security gaps. i'll ping legal.

Derek (Eng): schedule: sprint A (this week) - implement routing + audit logs + kms passthrough; sprint B - canary + telemetry + fallback. aim to launch pilot to ACME by end of sprint B.

ConsoleBot: CI pipeline: feature/parity-subset - tests passing (24/24), integration job queued.

Maya (ProdOps): ops note - we'll pre-provision burst capacity on Dedicated to avoid cold-start noise during pilot. costs estimated ~ +12% for pilot month.

Priya (PM): decision summary: go with parity-subset pilot + relaxed SLO (99.8) for pilot window + GA credits conditioned on 99.95. owners: Derek (eng), Sam (sre), Liam (sales). i'll post a short announcement to ACME and legal later today. thanks all :thumbsup:

Derek (Eng): I'll create the RFC and attach the minimal acceptance tests. starting now.

Sam (SRE): i'll put SLO runbook and alert playbook in the repo.

Liam (Sales): drafting agreement now, will loop in legal.

Priya (PM): closing thread. if anyone finds new blockers tag me.
